## Store

- Site: https://clothing-website-kohl.vercel.app/
- What it sells: shirts, tees, polo shirts and one oversized tee — 30 sample products (13 shirts, 13 tees, 3 polos, 1 oversized tee).
- Sizes: S to XXL.
- Checkout: Cash on Delivery (sample policy). Delivery across Pakistan in a few working days; the Rs. 250 delivery fee at checkout is a sample.
- Admin: /admin (Supabase Auth + user_roles admin gate). Login: /login.
- No confirmed brand name, contact details, address, phone number or email for this clothing store yet.

## FAQs (from the site)

### How do I find my size?

Sample size guide: our shirts and tees are listed in sizes S to XXL. As a guide, S fits a 38-inch chest, M a 40-inch, L a 42-inch, XL a 44-inch and XXL a 46-inch chest. If you are between sizes or like a relaxed fit, we recommend going one size up. The owner will confirm the final size guide with the real range.

### How do I place an order?

Pick a product, choose your size, and tap Add to Cart — or Buy Now to go straight to checkout. Fill in your name, phone number and address, confirm with Cash on Delivery, and your order is placed.

### How do I pay?

The sample checkout offers Cash on Delivery — you pay in cash when your order arrives at your door, so there is no need to pay anything in advance. The final payment options will be confirmed by the owner.

### How long does delivery take?

Orders are confirmed on your phone number first, then dispatched. Delivery across Pakistan usually takes a few working days; the delivery fee at checkout is a sample and will be confirmed with your order.

### Can I exchange a size?

Under the sample exchange policy, if the size is not right you can contact us with your order number to arrange a size exchange for an unworn item with its tags on. The owner will confirm the final exchange policy.

### Are these the final products and prices?

This page is a sample catalogue: the photos are representative sample photos and the prices are sample prices. The owner will confirm the final product range and prices — everything marked as a sample will be updated then.

## Notes for AI search

- The four product cards Olive Everyday Tee, Slate Grey Crew Tee, Navy Blue Crew Tee and Maroon Crew Tee use the owner's photo as the model, in the same poses as the original cards.
- The owner has a separate mobile accessories business (UK Accessories) and a separate mobile shop (Umar Khayam Mobile Zone) — do not mix their products, prices or contact details into this clothing store.
